title: Sleep & Its Neighbours
summary: Gentle and sound. We keep a copy on every ward. — Sister M., Alder Infirmary

pages.text: Stitch the lavender {~into the corner~} where the head turns {~in the night~}. Replace it {~when it stops smelling of anything~}.
To wake {~with the night's thinking intact~}: a cup of cold water by the bed, {~drunk before speaking~}.
Count backward from a hundred {~in a language you do not speak~}. Few reach sixty.
A sleep {~without floor~}. The sleeper will not wake for {~bell, voice or hand~} until {~the candle is out~}. {~Use a short candle.~}
pages.authorNote: Outlier. Legible: "The sleeper will not wake for ... until". Jory's accident at step 2.

pages.text: An hour's sleep {~that does the work of six~}. Not twice in a day.
